one_line: Kannagi, the chaste merchant’s wife who defies the Pandya court, and Neduncheliyan, the troubled king whose hasty justice reshapes Madurai’s moral memory.

appearance.age_look: Kannagi appears about 22, slim but sturdy; Neduncheliyan appears about 30, tall and broad-shouldered with a regal bearing.
appearance.face: Kannagi has an oval face, warm medium-brown complexion, large expressive eyes with a steady righteous gaze, straight nose, and a small beauty mark near her left cheek; her default expression is calm, tightly controlled anger with sorrow underneath. Neduncheliyan has a square jaw, slightly deeper brown complexion, sharp nose, thick arched brows, and a faint vertical worry line between the brows; his default expression is composed royal seriousness shading into guilt-ridden intensity.
appearance.hair: Kannagi’s hair is long, black, and thick, parted in the middle, drawn back into a low, heavy braid reaching past her waist, wrapped at intervals with narrow red cloth bands and finished with a modest cluster of white jasmine flowers at the end; no veil or crown, just a simple narrow gold forehead band. Neduncheliyan’s hair is black, shoulder-length, slightly wavy, pulled back from the forehead and tied into a short, neat low knot at the back with a dark red cloth tie, with a few controlled strands at the sides; he wears a modest gold Pandya diadem—a slim band with a central leaf-like motif—resting above the brow.
appearance.costume: Kannagi wears a historically grounded early-classical Tamil woman’s ensemble: a deep-red ankle-length cotton sari-style draped garment with a narrow golden-yellow border, wrapped securely around her waist and brought over her left shoulder, covering her torso fully and creating a layered, modest front; beneath it a cream-colored inner cloth (pavadai) shows slightly at the hem; she has a fitted short-sleeved blouse in muted maroon completely covered by the outer drape, and the fabric falls in clean, practical pleats at the front. She wears simple but dignified jewellery: a pair of small gold disc earrings, a single medium-width gold bangle on each wrist, a slim waist-cord with a tiny central pendant barely visible under the drape, and a plain toe ring on one foot hinted through the folds; her feet are bare but clean, appropriate to the climate and class. Neduncheliyan wears a Pandya king’s court costume grounded in early Tamilakam: a rich dark-teal ankle-length lower cloth (veshti) in fine cotton or light silk, with a broad gold border, wrapped in a classic dhoti style with neat front pleats; his upper body is modestly covered by a pale-cream, short-sleeved fitted tunic reaching to mid-thigh, over which he wears a dark-indigo silk angavastram (shawl) edged with gold that is draped diagonally from his left shoulder across his chest and around his back. His jewellery is regal but not overdone: a medium-width gold necklace with a single central pendant, two slim gold armlets on his upper arms, a pair of understated gold earrings shaped like small hoops, and a simple gold ring on his right hand; he wears brown leather sandals with simple straps.
appearance.signature: Kannagi’s signature prop is a single heavy anklet (silambu) in her right hand: a large, closed golden anklet ring about the width of her palm, with subtle incised patterns along its outer curve and a sense of weight, held tightly as both evidence and symbol of justice; Neduncheliyan’s signature prop is a straight, broad Pandya court sword sheathed at his left hip, with a plain steel blade, a simple cross-guard, and a dark-brown leather scabbard banded with two narrow gold rings, his right hand often resting lightly on the hilt.

ref_desc: Kannagi is a young Tamil woman with long black braided hair bound by red bands and jasmine, wearing a deep-red sari with golden-yellow border over a cream under-layer and modest jewellery, gripping a heavy golden anklet in her hand beside Neduncheliyan, a broad-shouldered king with shoulder-length tied-back black hair, a slim gold diadem, cream tunic, dark-teal dhoti, indigo shawl, modest gold ornaments, and a sheathed straight sword at his hip, all in a palette of deep red, gold, dark teal, cream, and indigo.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of two historically grounded early-classical Tamil figures standing side by side: Kannagi and the Pandya king Neduncheliyan, designed to be redrawn consistently. Kannagi is a young Tamil woman with an oval face, warm medium-brown skin, large intense eyes, and a calm yet burning expression; her long black hair is parted in the middle, drawn back into a thick low braid reaching past her waist, wrapped at intervals with narrow red cloth bands and finished with a small cluster of white jasmine flowers, with a slim gold band across her forehead. She wears a deep-red ankle-length sari-like draped garment with a narrow golden-yellow border, wrapped around her waist and brought over her left shoulder to cover her torso completely; a cream under-skirt peeks at the hem and a fitted maroon blouse is fully concealed by the drape. The fabric falls in neat pleats, her bare feet are visible, and she has small gold disc earrings, a pair of simple gold bangles, and a discreet waist-cord. She grips a single heavy golden anklet in one hand like a weighty ring of evidence. Beside her stands Neduncheliyan, tall and broad-shouldered, with a square-jawed face, deep-brown complexion, sharp nose, and serious, guilt-shadowed eyes; his black hair is shoulder-length, slightly wavy, pulled back and tied in a short low knot with a red cloth, and he wears a slim gold diadem with a central leaf-like motif above his brow. His outfit consists of a pale-cream, short-sleeved fitted tunic reaching mid-thigh, a dark-teal ankle-length dhoti-style lower cloth with a broad gold border, and a dark-indigo silk shawl with gold edging draped from his left shoulder across his chest. He wears modest gold jewellery—a central-pendant necklace, armlets, hoop earrings, a ring—and simple brown leather sandals. At his left hip hangs a straight, broad-bladed sword in a dark-brown leather scabbard banded with gold, his right hand resting lightly on the hilt. Emphasise an anime shonen aesthetic with clean lines, expressive eyes, and dynamic posing, while keeping all garments modest and historically plausible, and use a colour scheme dominated by deep red, golden yellow, dark teal, cream, and indigo.
